Metadata.title: AirClaims — claim your flight compensation yourself
Metadata.description: Delayed or cancelled flight? Claim up to €600 under EU261 yourself, with AI help. You only pay if you get paid.

Home.title: Your flight was delayed or cancelled? Claim up to €{long} yourself.
Home.subtitle: We prepare your claim, track the airline's answers and tell you what to do next. You stay the claimant and the money goes straight to you.
Home.amountMedium: 1,500 – 3,500 km, or longer within the EU
Home.amountsNote: Per passenger with a paid ticket, when you arrive {hours} hours late or more, or your flight is cancelled at short notice. Extraordinary circumstances (such as severe weather) can exempt the airline.
Home.step1Body: Flight number, date and what happened. We estimate if you're entitled to compensation.
Home.step2Body: We draft your claim. Nothing is sent to the airline until you read it and approve it.
Home.step3Body: The airline pays you directly. If they refuse, we guide you to AESA and, if needed, to court.
Home.feeTitle: You only pay if you get paid
Home.feeBody: {base}% of the compensation you receive, VAT included. Lower with more passengers, previous claims or referrals (never below {min}%). Expenses you get back are never charged.
Home.honestyBody: AirClaims is an assisted self-claim service. We are not a law firm and don't represent you: you are always the claimant, we never hold your money and we never accept an offer on your behalf.
Home.scorecardBody: Coming soon: how each airline responds to claims, based on real cases.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.description: We'll email you a link to sign in. No password needed.
Login.sentBody: If the address is valid, you'll receive a sign-in link in a few minutes. Open it on this device.
Login.errorSend: We couldn't send the link. Try again in a minute.
Login.errorLink: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
Login.privacy: We only use your email to sign you in and to contact you about your claims.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.description: We use these details to prepare your claims.
Profile.fullNameHint: As it appears on your booking.
Profile.personalEmailHint: We forward the airline's replies here.
Profile.errorSave: We couldn't save your profile. Try again.

Footer.disclaimer: AirClaims helps you claim for yourself. We are not a law firm and do not provide legal representation.

Wizard.title: Claim {flight} · {date}
Wizard.errorSave: We couldn't save your changes. Try again.
Wizard.draftSaved: Your claim is saved as a draft at every step.

Flight.title: Your flight
Flight.description: Tell us which flight was disrupted.
Flight.flightNumberHint: As on your booking, e.g. VY1234.
Flight.lookupFound: We found your flight and filled in the route. Please check it.
Flight.lookupFoundDelay: Our flight data suggests you arrived about {hours} h {minutes} min late. You'll confirm it in the next step.
Flight.lookupNotFound: We couldn't find this flight. Enter the route yourself.
Flight.lookupUnavailable: Flight lookup isn't available right now. Enter the route yourself.
Flight.lookupInvalid: Enter a valid flight number and a past date first.
Flight.airportUnknown: Choose an airport from the list.
Flight.hasConnection: This flight was part of a connection on the same booking
Flight.finalDestinationHint: Where your journey on this booking ended.
Flight.bookingReferenceHint: The code on your booking confirmation, e.g. ABC123.
Flight.lookupChecking: We're confirming this flight with our flight data. You can carry on: the data is added to your claim as soon as it's confirmed.
Flight.lookupFoundCancelled: Our flight data shows this flight was cancelled.
Flight.lookupRateLimited: You've checked many flights today. Enter the route yourself; we'll confirm the flight later.

Disruption.title: What happened
Disruption.delayLabel: How late did you arrive at your final destination?
Disruption.delayHint: From the scheduled arrival time to when the aircraft doors opened.
Disruption.noticeLabel: How many days before departure were you told about the cancellation?
Disruption.noticeHint: Enter 0 if you found out at the airport.
Disruption.reroutingLabel: Did the airline offer you an alternative flight?
Disruption.earlierLabel: How much earlier than your original flight did it leave?
Disruption.laterLabel: How much later than planned did it get you to your final destination?
Disruption.reasonLabel: What reason did the airline give?

reasons.airline_staff_strike: Strike by the airline's own staff
reasons.operational: Late incoming aircraft or operational reasons

Disruption.careLabel: What did the airline give you while you waited?
Disruption.careHint: Tick only what the airline provided. Anything you paid yourself goes under Expenses.

care.transport: Transport to the hotel or home

Disruption.instructionsLabel: What did airline staff tell you to do?
Disruption.instructionsHint: E.g. "Take a taxi home and claim it back". Include who, when and where if you remember.

Passengers.title: Passengers
Passengers.description: Everyone on this booking who travelled. You are the lead passenger and the claimant.
Passengers.freeTicket: Travelled on a free ticket (e.g. infant without a seat)
Passengers.freeTicketHint: Free tickets aren't entitled to compensation.
Passengers.errorLeadFree: The lead passenger must have a paid ticket.

Expenses.title: Expenses
Expenses.description: Costs you paid because of the disruption (meals, hotel, taxi…). They are claimed separately from the compensation and we never charge a fee on them.
Expenses.promised: Airline staff told me to pay for this and claim it back
Expenses.promiseDetails: Who told you, when and where? Do you have it in writing?

Documents.title: Documents
Documents.description: Your boarding pass and booking confirmation help prove you were on the flight. PDF or photo, up to 10 MB.
Documents.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
Documents.badType: Use a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, WEBP or HEIC).
Documents.missingHint: Don't have it at hand? You can continue and add it later.
Documents.idNotice: We only ask for an ID document if a later step needs it.

Review.title: Review your claim
Review.disclaimer: An estimate based on your answers, not legal advice.

verdict.possible: You may be entitled to compensation
verdict.unlikely: You're probably not entitled to compensation
verdict.unknown: We need a bit more information

Review.fee: Our fee, only if you're paid

reasons.claim_period_expired: The flight is more than 5 years ago, the limit for claiming in Spain.
reasons.out_of_scope: EU261 doesn't cover this flight: it left from outside the EU and wasn't operated by an EU airline.
reasons.scope_unknown: We couldn't confirm that EU261 covers this flight (unknown airport or airline).
reasons.delay_unknown: Tell us how late you arrived at your final destination.
reasons.delay_under_threshold: You arrived less than 3 hours late at your final destination.
reasons.delay_over_threshold: You arrived 3 hours or more late at your final destination.
reasons.notice_unknown: Tell us when you were told about the cancellation.
reasons.notice_14_days: You were told about the cancellation at least 14 days in advance.
reasons.rerouting_within_limits: The alternative flight you were offered was within the times the law allows.
reasons.rerouting_details_missing: Tell us the times of the alternative flight so we can confirm.
reasons.cancellation_late_notice: You were told about the cancellation less than 14 days in advance.
reasons.denied_boarding: You were denied boarding against your will.

flags.extraordinary_possible: The reason given may count as an extraordinary circumstance, which can exempt the airline. The airline has to prove it, and we'll still prepare your claim.
flags.long_haul_reduction: On flights over 3,500 km, a delay of 3 to 4 hours can halve the compensation.
flags.rerouting_reduction: The alternative flight arrived close to schedule, so the airline may halve the compensation.
flags.distance_unknown: We couldn't calculate the distance for this route.
flags.denied_boarding_voluntary: If you volunteered to give up your seat, compensation doesn't apply; the deal you accepted does.

Review.riskFlag: Our records show {type} around this flight. The airline may argue extraordinary circumstances.

riskTypes.airline_staff_strike: a strike by the airline's staff

Review.unlikelyNote: You can still send the claim: we never reject a claim for you. The final word is the airline's, AESA's or a court's.
Review.flightDataOnTime: Arrived on time or less than 15 min late

Sign.title: Sign
Sign.description: Read and accept these documents to send your claim. We keep a record of what you signed, when, your IP address and a fingerprint of the text.

accept.terms_of_service: I accept the terms of service
accept.privacy_notice: I have read the privacy notice
accept.email_authorization: I authorize AirClaims to send and receive email for this claim in my name

Sign.signedName: Type your full name to sign
Sign.changed: The texts changed while you were reading. Please review them again.

Done.title: Your claim is ready
Done.aliasBody: Give the airline this address as your contact email. We keep their replies in your claim and forward them to {email}.
Done.webFormIntro: {airline} takes claims through its website. You submit it yourself; it takes about 5 minutes.
Done.claimTextHint: Paste it into the form's description field. It asks for payment in money, not vouchers.
Done.referenceHint: Shown on screen or in the confirmation email after you submit.
Done.emailBody: {airline} accepts claims by email. We're preparing your claim email: you'll read and approve it before anything is sent.
Done.unknownBody: We don't have this airline's claim channel yet. We'll look it up and email you the next step. Meanwhile, here is your claim text.
Done.submittedBody: Sent on {date}. The airline must reply by {due}. If it doesn't reply or refuses, you can go to AESA until {aesa}.
Done.docsPendingBody: Add your boarding pass and booking confirmation when you can: they make your claim stronger.

finish_draft.title: Finish your claim
finish_draft.body: Your claim is saved as a draft. Complete the remaining steps to send it.

approve_email.title: Approve your message
approve_email.body: A message is ready to be sent in your name. Read it under Messages and approve it: nothing is sent until you do.

submit_web_form.title: Send your claim to {airline}
submit_web_form.body: Follow these steps, then tell us the airline's reference.

preparing_email.title: We're preparing your claim email
preparing_email.body: We'll email you when it's ready. You'll read and approve it before anything is sent.

no_channel.title: We're looking up how {airline} takes claims
no_channel.body: We'll email you the next step. Meanwhile, here is your claim text.

validating.title: We're checking your documents
validating.body: We'll let you know if anything needs your attention.

wait_airline.title: Waiting for the airline
wait_airline.body: The airline must reply by {due}. We'll forward their reply to you.

airline_overdue.title: The airline hasn't replied in time
airline_overdue.body: The one-month deadline passed on {due}. You can take your claim to AESA, whose decision is binding on the airline.

read_reply.title: The airline has replied
read_reply.body: Read the reply under Messages. If they refuse, or offer vouchers or a reduced amount, you don't have to accept: you can go to AESA.

wait_aesa.title: Your claim is with AESA
wait_aesa.body: AESA's decision is binding on the airline. We'll let you know when it arrives.

in_court.title: Your claim is in court
in_court.body: Keep an eye on letters from the court and tell us about any news.

check_payment.title: Check your payment
check_payment.body: The airline pays you directly. Let us know when the money arrives.

consider_court.title: You can still go to court
consider_court.body: In Spain, claims under €2,000 can go to court without a lawyer (juicio verbal).

Dashboard.aesaUntil: Last day to go to AESA: {date}.

deadline.aesa: Last day to go to AESA

Dashboard.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
Dashboard.confirmSend: Send this message to {recipient} from {alias}, in your name? This can't be undone.
Dashboard.approveError: We couldn't approve this message. Reload the page and try again.

event.email_drafted: A message was prepared for your approval
event.email_analyzed: We read a message about your claim

Dashboard.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this claim? We'll stop tracking it. If it was already sent, the airline may still reply to you.
Dashboard.withdrawError: We couldn't withdraw the claim. Try again.
Dashboard.prepareReminder: Prepare a reminder to the airline
Dashboard.draftRequested: We're preparing it. We'll email you when it's ready for your approval.
Dashboard.draftUnavailable: We couldn't start it right now. Try again in a few minutes.
Dashboard.subject: Subject
Dashboard.editHint: It's sent in your name: keep it factual and ask for payment in money, not vouchers.
Dashboard.editError: We couldn't save your changes. Reload the page and try again.
Dashboard.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? Nothing will be sent. You can ask for a new one.
Dashboard.discardError: We couldn't discard this draft. Reload the page and try again.

offer.title: The airline made an offer
offer.titleMoney: The airline says it will pay you
offer.body: You don't have to accept it. Under EU261 you're entitled to be paid in money; vouchers, travel credit or miles only count if you agree to them. We never accept anything on your behalf. If it's less than you claimed or not in money, you can ask to be paid in money or take the claim to AESA.
offer.bodyMoney: Check that the payment reaches you in money and for the full amount you claimed.

Dashboard.prepareOfferReply: Prepare a reply asking to be paid in money

stats.title: Airline stats
stats.description: Outcomes of claims handled here, per airline. Days are counted from the day the claim was sent.
stats.legend: Outcome: won / partly won / lost. Success rate counts resolved claims only. First reply: median days until the airline's first answer. Overdue: sent more than a month ago without an answer.

airlines.staleHint: Contacts not verified in the last {days} days are highlighted.

airline.title: Airline
airline.name: Name
airline.languageHint: Two-letter code of the language claims are written in (e.g. en, es).
airline.euCarrier: EU/EEA/CH carrier (EU261 applies to its flights into the EU)

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.tipsHint: One tip per line. Shown to passengers on their next-step screen and dashboard, in their language (falls back to English).
knowledge.draftingHint: Practical notes in English added to the drafting prompt for this airline (e.g. what to put in the subject). The usual guardrails still apply.
knowledge.formNotesHint: Form fields, login needed, quirks, anything still to verify.

contact.title: Contacts
contact.description: How passengers claim with this airline. Email addresses are never shown to passengers before a message is sent.
contact.label: Label
contact.labelHint: What passengers see, e.g. "Wizz Air – Claims & Compensation".
contact.valueHint: Email for the email channel, form URL for web forms.
contact.stepsHint: One step per line, per language. Shown to passengers for web forms.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Sourced facts about this airline, written in our own words. Mark them verified once checked.
insights.summaryHint: In our own words; don't paste copyrighted text.

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Messages and events that need a person: unmatched mail, passengers writing to us, offers and document requests.
review.aliasHint: The 6-character code or the full airclaims_… address.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: The last 200 changes: who changed what, before and after.

flights.addDescription: What really happened to a flight, from the passenger or a reliable source. Marked final, it's used for every claim on that flight and never sent to the paid flight API. Saving the same flight number and date again updates it.
flights.dateHint: Local date at the departure airport.
flights.offsetHint: e.g. +02:00 for Spain in summer, +01:00 in winter.
flights.actualArrHint: When the doors opened, if known.
flights.final: Final: this is what happened (no API check needed)
